scope: Corollary 6.3 (Ordinary subadditivity in characteristic zero) of the manuscript “Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Orbifold-and-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b143366cc99615e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let f : X → Y be a surjective morphism with connected fibers between smooth connected projective k-varieties. If F is its geometric generic fiber, then (6.8) κ(X) ≥ κ(F) + κ(Y ). More generally, the logarithmic inequality of Corollary 6.2, with the same boundary hypotheses, holds over k, with the geometric generic fiber in place of a very general complex fiber.
